```{python}
import htmltools
import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import numpy as np
import sys
import os
import datetime


project_root = os.path.abspath(os.path.join(os.getcwd(), '..'))

if project_root not in sys.path:
    sys.path.insert(0, project_root)

import src.chartkit as ck
from src.metrics_calculator import MetricsCalculator
from src.database import DatabaseManager

ck.apply_style()

calculator_30d = MetricsCalculator(db_path="../data/analytics.db", days=30)
calculator_60d = MetricsCalculator(db_path="../data/analytics.db", days=60)
calculator_90d = MetricsCalculator(db_path="../data/analytics.db", days=90)
calculator_all = MetricsCalculator(db_path="../data/analytics.db", days=None)

db = DatabaseManager("../data/analytics.db")

```

```{python}
def visualise_responder_diversity(calculator: MetricsCalculator) -> None:
    fig, ax = ck.question_figure("Who answers support questions — core team or community?")
    df = calculator.get_responder_diversity(freq='QE')
    if df.empty:
        ck.empty_state(ax, "No discussion responders in this period yet.")
        plt.tight_layout()
        plt.show()
        return
    df = df.copy()
    df['period'] = pd.to_datetime(df['period'])
    ck.bars(ax, df, x='period',
            series=[{'col': 'core_team_responders', 'label': 'Core team'},
                    {'col': 'community_responders', 'label': 'Community'}],
            ylabel='Unique responders', stacked=True)
    plt.tight_layout()
    plt.show()
```

```{python}
def visualise_discussions_by_category(calculator: MetricsCalculator) -> None:
    fig, ax = ck.question_figure("What kinds of discussions are people opening?")
    df = calculator.get_discussions_opened_by_category(freq='QE')
    if df.empty:
        ck.empty_state(ax, "No discussions opened in this period yet.")
        plt.tight_layout()
        plt.show()
        return
    df = df.copy()
    df['period'] = pd.to_datetime(df['period'])
    pivot = df.pivot_table(index='period', columns='category', values='count',
                           fill_value=0, sort=False)
    pivot = pivot.sort_index().reset_index()
    categories = [c for c in pivot.columns if c != 'period']
    series = [{'col': c, 'label': str(c)} for c in categories]
    ck.bars(ax, pivot, x='period', series=series,
            ylabel='Discussions opened', stacked=True)
    plt.tight_layout()
    plt.show()
```

```{python}
def visualise_discussion_response_trend(calculator: MetricsCalculator) -> None:
    fig, ax = ck.question_figure("How quickly does someone respond to a support question?")
    df = calculator.get_discussion_response_trend(freq='QE')
    if df.empty:
        ck.empty_state(ax, "No discussion responses to chart yet.")
        plt.tight_layout()
        plt.show()
        return
    df = df.copy()
    df['period'] = pd.to_datetime(df['period'])
    ck.timeseries(ax, df, x='period',
                  series=[{'col': 'median_days', 'label': 'Median first response'}],
                  ylabel='Days to first response')
    plt.tight_layout()
    plt.show()
```
